entities.summary: Hayk Ghazaryan was an Armenian historian and professor nominated to 2007 Nobel Prize for his "The Armenian Genocide in the Ottoman Empire" academic work. It consists of 2 volumes and was translated into Russian, Turkish and a number of European languages. Ghazaryan died in August 2014.
